description: This file defines the 'Networks' class within the WPEFramework::Broadcast namespace, which manages DVB network information, scanning, and notification handling for tuner devices. It includes nested classes for notification sink, section parser, and network data representation, along with methods for scanning, retrieving network info, and handling tuner state changes.

classes.name: Networks
classes.description: Manages DVB network scanning, storage, and notification for tuner devices.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a DVB network with properties like network ID, frequency, modulation, and name.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Handles parsing of DVB section data related to network information.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for networks.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Retrieves a network by its ID.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the stored networks.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads network data from a DVB::NIT table.
